rows: Spring 2026 update was published on 13 May 2026.
The update reports existing coverage as of January 2026.
It is an interim update to Connected Nations 2025.
Connected Nations 2025 was based on July 2025 data.
Fixed broadband availability includes fixed-line networks.
Fixed broadband availability includes fixed wireless access networks.
The update reports full-fibre service take-up.
Decent broadband requires at least 10 Mbit/s download.
Decent broadband requires at least 1 Mbit/s upload.
Full fibre was available to 24.9 million residential premises.
Full fibre covered 82% of UK homes.
Headline residential percentages use 30.5 million homes.
Full-fibre availability increased by 1.2 million homes in six months.
Full-fibre take-up increased by 1.8 million connections in six months.
Take-up equalled 47% of premises with access to full fibre.
Take-up covers residential and commercial premises.
The comparable July 2025 count was 26.4 million homes.
39,000 premises lacked decent fixed-line or FWA broadband.
The comparable July 2025 fixed/FWA gap was 44,000 premises.
Ofcom used AddressBase Premium and Islands Epoch 123.
Fixed coverage metadata was revised as V2 on 7 July 2026.
Duplicate CW/CV and MK/ME postcode files were corrected.

os_linked.source: Ordnance Survey OS Open Linked Identifiers
rows: OS Open Linked Identifiers cross-references UPRNs, USRNs and TOIDs.
The relationships are described as authoritative.
Relationship data is delivered in CSV format.
The product is updated every six weeks.
Each release is a full supply.
Releases follow the corresponding AddressBase Premium release.
Geometry is not included in the relationship product.
Geometry must come from OS Open UPRN, OS Open USRN or OS Open TOID.
UDPRNs are excluded because third-party intellectual property applies.
The download contains 11 relationship ZIP packages.
Each relationship ZIP contains four files.
Each package contains one relationship CSV.
Each package contains OGL licence text.
Each package contains a relationship-description PDF.
BLPU UPRN links to TopographicArea TOID through method 5.
BLPU UPRN links to RoadLink TOID through method 9.
BLPU UPRN links to Street USRN through method 11.
Version JSON records the linked CSV filename.
productPublicationName records the Linked Identifier epoch.
Identifier1Source records source product and publication information.
Identifier2Source records source product and publication information.
Source epoch fields may be omitted when null.
Rows may include version numbers and dates for both identifiers.
Confidence may say version information is correct.
Confidence may say version information potentially changed.
Confidence may say version information changed.
A relationship may no longer be valid after source changes.
The API exposes product-version information by correlation method.
Testing the API requires an API key or OAuth2 token.
OS Open UPRN contains AddressBase Premium record positions and UPRNs.
The product supports linking datasets by UPRN.
The product supports linking by address-point position.
CSV is supplied as one Great Britain file.
GeoPackage is supplied as one Great Britain file.
The product is refreshed every six weeks.
All UPRNs are included regardless of lifecycle state.
Addressable locations can include ponds or bus shelters.
GeoPackage FID is autogenerated and non-persistent.
UPRN is an integer field with multiplicity one.
X_COORDINATE is in British National Grid metres.
Y_COORDINATE is in British National Grid metres.
The point represents the address-record location.
GeoPackage geometry is in British National Grid.
UPRN presence alone does not prove an active building.
An address point does not establish a parcel polygon.
The actual downloaded package epoch was not captured.
No OS Open UPRN package hash was verified.

hmlr_inspire.source: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Index Polygons
rows: The current INSPIRE dataset was published on 5 July 2026.
New files are published on the first Sunday of each month.
A publication contains data from the previous month.
Files remain available until the next publication.
The dataset covers registered freehold property in England and Wales.
INSPIRE is a subset of the Index Polygons database.
Files are divided by local-authority area.
A boundary polygon can appear in both authority files.
Polygons show indicative position and extent.
Each polygon has a Land Registry INSPIRE ID.
The INSPIRE ID relates to a registered title.
INSPIRE ID can support Find a Property title lookup.
A title may contain multiple separate polygons.
Separate polygons have separate INSPIRE IDs.
INSPIRE polygons do not establish exact registered extent.
The title plan is required to establish registered extent.
Open INSPIRE ID is not documented as a UPRN.
INSPIRE ID is not the project's parcel identifier.
Files are published in GML format.
A GIS is required to view the polygons.
The dataset is supplied under OGL conditions.
The catalogue lists an average GML size of 13.66 MB.
The catalogue states that no API is available.
GML is used as an open-standard data structure.
HMLR captures data against British National Grid.
GML can be converted to Shapefile, GeoJSON and KML.
EPSG:3857 is an example web-map target CRS.
BNG-to-WGS84 reprojection can shift features by up to 15 metres.
No July 2026 GML bytes were captured.
No GML hash or physical feature count was verified.
INSPIRE geometry alone cannot promote a product row.

hmlr_nps.source: HM Land Registry National Polygon Service
rows: National Polygon Service is a licensed, chargeable HMLR service.
One component is the National Polygon dataset.
One component is the Title Descriptor dataset.
One component is the Title Number and UPRN Look Up dataset.
The datasets are available only as part of the service.
Use requires agreement to a licence.
Published annual price is £20,000 plus VAT.
The service describes more than 25 million titles.
Every freehold or leasehold title has at least one index polygon.
The polygon dataset contains polygon shape.
Poly_ID is the unique polygon reference.
INSERT records initial polygon creation date.
UPDATE records when the title polygon was last updated.
Rec_Status distinguishes added, changed and deleted records.
National polygons link to other HMLR products through Title_No.
The UPRN lookup dataset is the official title-to-UPRN route.
Open INSPIRE does not expose that full lookup.
It is updated on the second working day of the month.
A delivery contains data for the previous month.
HMLR index polygons are mapped against OS MasterMap.
Index polygons show indicative location, not guaranteed exact ownership.
A registered title can have more than one polygon.
A title-to-UPRN bridge must handle one-to-many relations.
No NPS licence or package is available in this runtime.
The paid service is not an available open dependency.
An open parcel-to-UPRN route remains unverified.
Documentation alone cannot promote a project product row.
